Job Description

We are looking for a Software Engineer (C/C++) to join our Experian Data Quality Team.

The Address Data Quality team guide the direction of, and deliver enhancements to our real-time and bulk address capture solutions (https://www.edq.com/products/address-verification/).

You will report to the Software Development Team lead.

This is a hybrid job role, based in Sofia.

What You'll Do

As a member of our agile team you'll play an important part in shaping the future of our address data quality capabilities. Also, react to the ever-changing needs of our users and always look for ways to work and deliver more effectively.

Essentially You Will

Support a variety of products and solutions in a range of programming languages – C/C++, C#/.Net, with some Python and Java in the mix.
You will take ownership of all aspects of delivery to create products that customers love.
Build an understanding of the team's products and of user stories on the product backlog to ensure participation in backlog grooming and sprint planning.
Contribute to the continued evolution of a self-organising team
Work with other team members to prepare for and deliver feature demos and showcase to internal clients and customers.
You will want to understand customers' needs through regular direct contact with customers and networking with members of customer-facing parts of the business.
You will contribute to a culture where the fair treatment of customers is at the heart of the Experian business.

What You Will Bring

Of graduate caliber or equivalent qualifications or experience
C, C++ programming experience
A programming enthusiasm
Flexibility and adaptability to learn and understand new technologies
Experience approaching a problem from different angles, analyzing pros and cons of different solutions
Fluency in written and spoken English.

Desirable

Knowledge and appreciation of Agile development methodologies and techniques
Knowledge/ 3+ years of experience with testing techniques, automated testing and the value of a test-first approach to deliver a high-quality solution that meets client needs
Exposure to DevOps concepts, practices, and tools

Qualifications

Of graduate caliber or equivalent qualifications or experience
3+ years of C, C++ programming experience
Flexibility and adaptability to learn and understand new technologies
Fluency in written and spoken English.
